# Scenario: any custom network_mode is stripped before stack start (no opt-in).
# README Host-Network Control — stacks stay on bridge / managed proxy nets.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: custom network_mode fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'stripping network_mode=host'
stderr 'stripping network_mode=bridge'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-netmode-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-netmode-side

# Runtime must not keep compose network_mode values.
exec sh -c 'mode=$(docker inspect -f "{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}" $(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-netmode-web)); echo "web_network_mode=$mode"; test "$mode" != "host"'
exec sh -c 'mode=$(docker inspect -f "{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}" $(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-netmode-side)); echo "side_network_mode=$mode"; test "$mode" != "bridge"'

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-netmode/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'network_mode' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-netmode/docker-compose.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-netmode
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9997
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-netmode/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    network_mode: host
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
  side:
    image: alpine:latest
    network_mode: bridge
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- .env --
